assumptions: SPEC-070 schema, configuration and store are merged; Claude Code and OpenCode run headless on the owner's subscription; the macOS OS sandbox of the SPEC-069 driver is available for real runs; SPEC-069 FREEZE, prompt sets and scoring are unchanged; OD-1 and OD-2 are open.
compatibility: Additive: scripts/spec069_native_runs.py keeps its CLI and evidence format and its tests are the regression gate; no existing output changes; new records braid-lightning-rollout/v0.1 and braid-lightning-reward/v0.1.
domain: Braid Lightning BL.1: subscription-only rollouts of host models on the SPEC-069 prompt sets and a program-computed reward vector over analyze-work requests.
execution_contract: executionAuthorization stays false; no execute, recover, grant or MCP-started runs; rollouts use disposable profiles, an OS sandbox and the host subscription route only; any *_API_KEY in a child environment is refused; extra cash spend EUR 0.
hypotheses: None; engineering specification with no scientific claim.
observation_contract: Each rollout records host, host version, model, key source, credential presence (boolean), prompt and candidate hashes, redacted transcript hash, reward vector and hash, stop and refusal codes; fake-host evidence is labelled pipeline-only.

scenarios.given: a configuration with parallel 1 and a fake host that hangs

obtained_evidence.limits: Fake hosts only; parallel greater than 1 is not implemented (the profile default and REQ-003 bound are 1).
obtained_evidence.outcome: passed: Rollouts run sequentially in a disposable sandboxed profile, follow the SPEC-070 state machine, write rollout, event and attempt-result records through the store; a timeout fails the rollout; a straggler process is detected and killed at teardown.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the hanging rollout ends as rollout-timeout with its tree killed, no more than one rollout runs at a time, and every record follows the state machine.
scenarios.when: the runner executes the rollout set

requirements.text: lightning_runner runs one subprocess rollout per prompt, repetition and host in a disposable profile, enforces timeoutSeconds and maxTurns, kills the process tree and verifies no leftover process, runs at most rollout.parallel at once (default 1), follows the SPEC-070 state machine and writes the unchanged braid-lightning-rollout/v0.1 records and braid-lightning-attempt-result/v0.1 records (new store kind result) through lightning_store.

obtained_evidence.limits: What a real subscription sign-in reports is not yet observed; the value none stays a fixture assumption until the real baseline (T012).

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.

requirements.text: The runner refuses paid-route-refused before launch if the child environment has a variable ending in _API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK or CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX; it records the host apiKeySource; a missing apiKeySource ends the rollout route-unverified and stops the run; oauth is accepted; none is accepted only as the SPEC-069 fixture assumption pending T003 evidence; any other value outside SUBSCRIPTION_KEY_SOURCES is route-unverified.

scientific_limits: Engineering only. Rewards are empirical measurements on the observed host versions, models and prompt sets, not guarantees. The baseline route-changed comparison compares proportions to a 95 % Wilson interval from 30 trials per host; it does not establish stable model behaviour.
scope: Specification only: extracted host helpers, a subscription-only rollout runner with hooks, a verifiable reward vector, anti-reward-hacking controls, CLI run/status/report, a fake-host CI pipeline and one real baseline run.
